regulator: Public Service Commission of Wisconsin. Wisconsin has no integrated resource plan rule. The Commission's Strategic Energy Assessment (docket 5-ES-113, 2026 to 2032 draft issued June 29, 2026) and each utility's investor updates and rate case filings play that role. Minnesota's commission holds the Upper Midwest plan for Xcel and the optional plan for Dairyland.

utilities.sheet_note: WPPI publishes no formal plan; these two documents open and describe its resource planning The plan reader marks both documents unread because they are short, but the text is saved and was read: a WPPI news page (https://wppienergy.org/powering-ahead/) says WPPI has room for about 400 MW of new resources by 2033 and that wind plus gas-fired combustion turbines look like the best choice; the 2025 slide deck says the same in less detail.
